_comment: Single source of truth for directory names that must never appear in the knowledge graph, the file tree, or _catalog.md files. Consumed by server.js at runtime. FRAMEWORK-SLICE NOTE: this is the slice's DEFAULT exclude set; an instance should generate it from company_profile.excludes.dirs (the manifest guardrails) rather than hand-editing — the same list feeds the kb-walk / kb-index tools and the catalog walker, so keep those in sync.
